reviews.review_description: A comprehensive putting app with lots of depth. Tons of data, training modules, and 18 hole rounds on replica greens of several famous courses will keep you busy for a long time. Whatever part of your game needs work, you'll find targeted tools to work on that here and keep your putting game sharp. You can use a real putter and ball in launch monitor mode, or purchase their adapter to attach to your own club for Mixed or full Virtual Reality play. Presentation is polished and clean and you can choose to have many windows of data open as you play or you can connect the app to your Meta account and see all of this information including leaderboards online when away from the game.  1v1 multiplayer is currently supported in full course and several mini games. Devs are actively involved in their Discord server.

reviews.review_title: Brilliant Drills with or with AR
reviews.review_description:
This simulator has come so far in such a short time. And has progressed into a real useful putting simulator. With the launch monitor data you can see why you are pulling shots and whether it’s your patch or club face. Really useful to iron out those details. It’s great for round the clock drills on different slopes. So you can go up hill and downhill and also banknladt and right - Extremely useful for knowing speed based on Green conditions. Then there are games and challenges if you want to show off your skills.
This is a brilliant addition to VR and with the new AR feature using a real ball - you can take it as step further to ‘feel’ the putt for distance.
Great Job and Highly recommended.

I have worked with this 'game' for a few months now and found a massive improvement to my putting.

There are various options to choose from to help with improving your putting; Stroke Control, Distance Control and Alignment among others.

The amount of data gathered is brilliant, all visible through the many widgets and will definately help with understanding what you are doing right and where you are going wrong.

The feel is very real and makes putting practice a lot more fun.

I would highly recommend trying it.

reviews.review_title: Fantastic Way to Improve Your Putting at
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been testing PutterVR for quite a long time now, and it’s been great to see just how much it has improved and developed along the way. It genuinely keeps getting better and better.

It’s a fantastic and fun way to work on your putting from home, with a great selection of training drills that help you improve everything from distance control and accuracy to consistency and confidence on the greens.

What I really like is that it doesn’t feel like a boring practice session. The drills keep things enjoyable while still feeling genuinely useful for improving your real-world putting.

If you’re a golfer looking to sharpen your putting and get more meaningful practice in at home, I’d definitely recommend giving PutterVR a try.

reviews.review_title: Home Practice That Actually Improves You
reviews.review_description: As a new golfer still learning , PutterVR and being able to use my actual putter has been a game‑changer for me and being part of the early Beta testing  came at just the right time for me . Being able to practise at home whenever I have a spare few minutes has massively improved my confidence on the course. The feedback, and consistency I get in VR translate directly into better putting during real rounds. It’s become an essential part of how I’m learning the game.

Putting has improved and Hcp down by 3.8 to 14.1 since using it. 

Love the durability and feedback. 

Look forward to more scenery options in the future? 

5/5
